description: This file contains Bash script functions for validating, reading, and modifying boot configuration files for a device, including magic number validation and partition management.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic headers in a boot config file to ensure it is a legitimate boot configuration.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Reads the number of partitions from the boot config file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Gets the index of a specific partition by name within the boot config file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Retrieves the primary boot partition index for a given partition name.

methods.name: _set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag (0 or 1) for a specific partition in the boot config file.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Public function to set the primary boot flag for a partition, performing validation and invoking internal method.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot flag between 0 and 1 for a specified partition.
